features.name: log_p3_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed P3 value normalized by training mean and std to create a smooth continuous score suitable for linear margins
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skewness of P3 distribution, enabling linear SVM to find better separating hyperplanes

features.name: p6p4_severity_score
features.description: Clipped and scaled P6p4 value emphasizing deviation from near-zero baseline, capturing tail behavior
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights extreme P6p4 values which may be discriminative for linear SVM boundaries

features.name: p11p3_centered
features.description: P11p3 centered around training mean and scaled by std for zero-mean unit-variance approximation
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardized feature improves SVM margin optimization by equalizing feature scales

features.name: p16p2_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of P16p2 from its training mean, measuring how far each observation is from typical values
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures outlier behavior in P16p2 which may correlate with decision boundaries

features.name: p19p2_h5p2_ratio
features.description: Ratio of P19p2 to H5p2 with smoothing to avoid division by zero, capturing relative magnitude relationship
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio features can capture non-linear interactions in a form usable by linear SVM

features.name: h15p1_normalized
features.description: H15p1 normalized to [0,1] range using observed min and max from training data
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized H15p1 on consistent scale improves SVM convergence and margin quality

features.name: composite_proportion_score
features.description: Weighted composite of proportion-type features P11p3, P16p2, and H40p4 as a linear projection
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear combination of correlated proportion features approximates a principal component useful for SVM

features.name: p3_log_sqrt_interaction
features.description: Interaction between log-transformed P3 and sqrt of P6p4 to capture joint behavior of these two features
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures multiplicative relationship between P3 and P6p4 in a smooth form for linear SVM

features.name: high_p19p2_indicator
features.description: Soft indicator for elevated P19p2 values above the mean plus one std, using smooth clipping
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth binary-like signal for high P19p2 regime that linear SVM can use as a feature

features.name: h40p4_balance_score
features.description: Measures how close H40p4 is to 0.5 (balanced midpoint), with higher scores for values near extremes
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures whether H40p4 is near its midpoint or extreme, providing useful signal for linear boundaries

features.name: multi_feature_severity
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall feature severity combining P6p4 sparsity, P19p2 elevation, and H5p2 magnitude into a holistic severity score from 0 (low severity) to 1 (high severity)
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a semantically meaningful composite severity measure that may align with decision boundaries in ways individual features do not

features.name: proportion_consistency_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of internal consistency among proportion features P11p3, P16p2, P19p2, and H40p4, scoring 0 for highly inconsistent proportions and 1 for mutually consistent proportion patterns
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures whether proportion features tell a coherent story, which may be a strong signal for linear SVM classification
